theorems.name: Submission.smr_ofReal_integral_le_massOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x) ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in A, v x (φ x) ∂μ) ≤ S.massOn W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
